{"command":"python3 - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
r=Decimal('130'); ot=Decimal('9'); rate=Decimal('23.1'); mult=Decimal('1.73'); wh=Decimal('0.2137'); d=Decimal('138')

n=g*(1-wh)-d
q=Decimal('0.01')
print(g, g.quantize(q, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN))
print(n, n.quantize(q, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN))
print('if gross rounded first',g.quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)*(1-wh)-d, (g.quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)*(1-wh)-d).quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN))
